professionalSummary: DevOps Engineer with hands‑on experience managing Kubernetes clusters, writing Terraform infrastructure as code, building Grafana dashboards and alerts, conducting resilience tests, and operating services in a regulated production environment. Holds a recognized Kubernetes Administrator certification.
experienceHighlights: Wrote Terraform modules and Helm charts for UAT and performance‑test clusters of the settlement‑file service (src_abeadaf18a67).

Built Grafana dashboards and alert rules for the settlement‑file service in pre‑production, covering queue depth, file‑generation latency and failed transfers, and tuned thresholds during performance tests (src_5819252e29c2).
Ran fault‑injection tests in the performance‑test cluster, killing pods and throttling the database link during simulated end‑of‑day runs, and documented recovery times (src_69caf174f936).

Handed each release candidate to the client bank’s release management team, which held production change approval and carried out deployments; answered questions during each release window (src_d5ad2547735d).

Wrote the operational handover document for the settlement‑file service, describing alerts, dependencies and restart steps for the production support team, which signed it off at handover (src_6073aa245851).
projectsAndWorkSamples: Performance‑test report for the settlement‑file service, showing throughput at one, two and three times the expected end‑of‑day volume and recovery times from fault‑injection runs (src_987572459fbb).
